Composer states: empty, focused, text entered, sending, disabled, and recoverable error. Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a line break; send button is disabled while empty or sending.
Assistant states: streaming, complete, interrupted, and error. Show a small live status while streaming; expose retry on recoverable error; copy action appears on completed answers and reports copied feedback for 2 seconds.
Navigation states: selected conversation, hover, keyboard focus, and collapsed rail. Context drawer opens by button and closes by button or Escape.
Unknown: actual keyboard map, retry semantics, cancellation behavior, and persistence of drafts.
